NOTE
**Still not ready**

The description now has a long section on how this PR relates to #33086. The author says they also fixed the whitespace case with a test, but I couldn't compare the code before and after, so that push is unconfirmed. The screenshots still look the same as before.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now discusses completion candidate #33086: same strategy, a different way of detecting `](`, and a lower line count. |
| ❌  | The screenshots are still not a clear before/after comparison. There are 4 "before" images and 2 "after" images with no captions, plus separate videos, so the scenarios don't line up. |
| ⚠️  | The continuing-unfinished-work guide asks authors to build on the existing PR's work. This is a fresh reimplementation instead, and a maintainer should decide whether that is acceptable. |
| ℹ️  | The whitespace fix (`]( #**…**)`) and its test are claimed but not verified, because the code diff since the feedback is unknown. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for a paired before/after presentation of the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the comparison with #33086. The screenshots still aren't set up for easy review: please show each scenario as a matched before/after pair (for example, a table with the same input in both columns) with a short caption, following the [guide on presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots). Also please say why you're not building on the commits from #33086, as the [continuing unfinished work guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html) describes.
```
